description:
List top-level comments on one of the account's media objects.

Replies are nested one level deeper — use instagram_list_comment_replies for a specific thread. Hidden comments are included with hidden=true.

Example: "what are people saying on our latest post" -> first instagram_list_media, then this with that media_id

after.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call's next_cursor.

media_id.description: Media ID whose comments to read

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

name: instagram_list_comments
title: List Comments
